slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: line
slots.about: one line under it: what the notices are for

slots.name: kinds
slots.about: what can be sent: id, name, on (true at the start for the suggested ones)

slots.name: samples
slots.about: sample notices, newest first: id, kind (a kind id), who, line, ago (a short time text)

slots.name: none_text
slots.about: shown in place of the samples when no kind is on

slots.name: asked_text
slots.about: the line while the phone's own question is showing

slots.name: granted_text
slots.about: the line once the phone allowed it

slots.name: denied_text
slots.about: the line once the phone said no: where to change it

slots.name: again_text
slots.about: the button after a skip that asks after all

host_events.value: the host shows the phone's own question after this rule
"granted" or "denied", sent by the host after the phone's answer

empty.shows: none in place of the samples; allow dimmed

attention.shows: status_line: asked, granted, denied or skipped

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise and shrink
